test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Abhiram returned back to the signal / and gave his last hundred rupee note / to the man / who had said he needed help.

options.text: Abhiram returned back to the signal
who had said he needed help
and gave his last hundred rupee note

solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **Abhiram returned back to the signal**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Remove "**back**" to correct the sentence.
 
• **'Returned' **is already mentioned in the sentence, which means to come or go back to a place.
 
• So, we can say the word "return" and "back" are similar in meaning.
 
• Therefore, using "**returned back**" doesn't make any sense.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**, which contains an error.

**Corrected sentence:** *Abhiram returned to the signal and gave his last hundred rupee note to the man who had said he needed help. *
